SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT WHERE BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND BIZ_NO = #{bizNo}

SELECT ST.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, ST.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, ST.SETTLE_MONTH AS settleMonth, ST.PERIOD_START AS periodStart, ST.PERIOD_END AS periodEnd, ST.TOTAL_SALES AS totalSales, ST.TOTAL_FEE AS totalFee, ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, ST.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, ST.SETTLE_STATUS AS settleStatus, ST.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, ST.PAY_DATE AS payDate, ST.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, ST.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, B.SETTLE_BANK AS settleBank, B.SETTLE_ACCOUNT AS settleAccount, B.SETTLE_HOLDER AS settleHolder FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = ST.BIZ_NO WHERE ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND NVL(ST.PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'FAIL'
ORDER BY ST.PERIOD_START DESC, ST.SETTLE_ID DESC

SELECT ST.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, ST.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, ST.SETTLE_MONTH AS settleMonth, ST.PERIOD_START AS periodStart, ST.PERIOD_END AS periodEnd, ST.TOTAL_SALES AS totalSales, ST.TOTAL_FEE AS totalFee, ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, ST.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, ST.SETTLE_STATUS AS settleStatus, ST.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, ST.PAY_DATE AS payDate, ST.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, ST.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, B.SETTLE_BANK AS settleBank, B.SETTLE_ACCOUNT AS settleAccount, B.SETTLE_HOLDER AS settleHolder FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = ST.BIZ_NO WHERE ST.SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY'

SELECT SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID AS settleItemId, SI.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, NVL(SI.ITEM_TYPE, 'STAY') AS itemType, SI.RESV_ID AS resvId, SI.ROOM_ID AS roomId, SI.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, SI.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, SI.RESV_AMOUNT AS resvAmount, SI.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, SI.FEE_AMOUNT AS feeAmount, SI.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, SI.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, SR.NAME AS roomName FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI JOIN TB_SETTLEMENT ST ON ST.SETTLE_ID = SI.SETTLE_ID AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' LEFT JOIN TB_RESERVATION R ON R.RESV_ID = SI.RESV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = SI.ROOM_ID WHERE SI.SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} ORDER BY SI.CHECKOUT_DATE ASC, SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID ASC

#{id}
UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT SET PAY_STATUS = 'FAIL' WHERE SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' AND NVL(PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT'
mapper.select: SELECT SETTLE_ID FROM TB_SETTLEMENT WHERE BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' AND NVL(PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT' ORDER BY SETTLE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST R JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = R.BIZ_NO WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED' AND B.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY'

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, R.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, SR.NAME AS roomName, R.TARGET_START AS targetStart, R.TARGET_END AS targetEnd, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.REQUESTED_AT AS requestedAt, R.APPROVED_AT AS approvedAt, R.REJECTED_AT AS rejectedAt FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST R JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = R.BIZ_NO AND B.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID
WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED'
ORDER BY R.REQUESTED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT WHERE BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE'
AND BIZ_NO = #{bizNo}

SELECT ST.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, ST.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, ST.SETTLE_MONTH AS settleMonth, ST.PERIOD_START AS periodStart, ST.PERIOD_END AS periodEnd, ST.TOTAL_SALES AS totalSales, ST.TOTAL_FEE AS totalFee, ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, ST.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, ST.SETTLE_STATUS AS settleStatus, ST.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, ST.PAY_DATE AS payDate, ST.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, ST.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, B.SETTLE_BANK AS settleBank, B.SETTLE_ACCOUNT AS settleAccount, B.SETTLE_HOLDER AS settleHolder FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = ST.BIZ_NO WHERE ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE'
AND NVL(ST.PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'FAIL'
ORDER BY ST.PERIOD_START DESC, ST.SETTLE_ID DESC

SELECT ST.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, ST.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, ST.SETTLE_MONTH AS settleMonth, ST.PERIOD_START AS periodStart, ST.PERIOD_END AS periodEnd, ST.TOTAL_SALES AS totalSales, ST.TOTAL_FEE AS totalFee, ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, ST.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, ST.SETTLE_STATUS AS settleStatus, ST.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, ST.PAY_DATE AS payDate, ST.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, ST.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, B.SETTLE_BANK AS settleBank, B.SETTLE_ACCOUNT AS settleAccount, B.SETTLE_HOLDER AS settleHolder FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = ST.BIZ_NO WHERE ST.SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE'

SELECT SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID AS settleItemId, SI.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, NVL(SI.ITEM_TYPE, 'ORDER_ITEM') AS itemType, SI.ORDER_ID AS orderId, SI.ORDER_ITEM_ID AS orderItemId, SI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, SI.CONFIRMED_AT AS confirmedAt, SI.ITEM_SALES_AMOUNT AS itemSalesAmount, SI.DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT AS deliveryFeeAmount, SI.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, SI.FEE_AMOUNT AS feeAmount, SI.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, SI.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, NVL(O.ORDER_NO, TO_CHAR(SI.ORDER_ID)) AS orderNo, NVL(OI.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS productName FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI JOIN TB_SETTLEMENT ST ON ST.SETTLE_ID = SI.SETTLE_ID AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' LEFT JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = SI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID = SI.ORDER_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = SI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SI.SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} ORDER BY SI.CONFIRMED_AT ASC, SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT SET PAY_STATUS = 'DONE', SETTLE_STATUS = 'PAID', PAY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' AND NVL(PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') IN ('WAIT', 'FAIL')
UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT SET PAY_STATUS = 'FAIL' WHERE SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' AND NVL(PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT'
mapper.select: SELECT SETTLE_ID FROM TB_SETTLEMENT WHERE BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' AND NVL(PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT' ORDER BY SETTLE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST R JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = R.BIZ_NO WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED' AND B.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE'

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, R.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, R.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, R.TARGET_START AS targetStart, R.TARGET_END AS targetEnd, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.REQUESTED_AT AS requestedAt, R.APPROVED_AT AS approvedAt, R.REJECTED_AT AS rejectedAt FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST R JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = R.BIZ_NO AND B.BIZ_TYPE = 'STORE' LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID
WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED'
WHERE R.STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED'
ORDER BY R.REQUESTED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC
